verdict.rationale: Milvus documents built-in server-side conversion of raw text into sparse embeddings for full-text search, so it generates vectors from text without a separate pipeline for that sparse case. Nothing in the evidence shows dense embeddings produced from configured model providers at ingest or query time, and the GitHub search example passes client-supplied query vectors. Missing for 10: documented built-in or configured model-provider integration for dense embeddings, explicit coverage of both ingest-time and query-time generation for model-based embeddings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can have the database generate embeddings at ingest and query time using built-in or configured model providers, instead of running a separate embedding pipeline

citations.quote: it simplifies vector searches by accepting raw text input, automatically converting your text data into sparse embeddings without the need to manually generate vector embeddings
